# Menus

Menus are keyed lists of items that target a page, an anchor on a page, or a URL. Navbar and footer components show a menu by its key.

[`navigation.read`](#navigationread) · [`navigation.anchors`](#navigationanchors) · [`navigation.upsert`](#navigationupsert) · [`navigation.delete`](#navigationdelete) · [`navigation.reorder`](#navigationreorder)

## navigation.read

Read the draft menus of the site and their revision: each menu with its key (what the `menu` prop of a nav list, a menu dialog's list or the footer names), its label and its items. An item has an id, a translatable `label` and a `target` of kind `page` { pageId }, `anchor` { pageId, anchor }, `external` { href } (an absolute, mail or phone link) or `languages` (one link per site locale); a top-level item may hold one level of `children`, and a child's `group` titles its column. A page or anchor target names its page by id. Menus are versioned with the site: publish copies them, and the public site serves the published ones.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { navigation: { revision: integer ≥0, menus: { key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80), items: { id: …, label: …, target: …, children?: … }[] (≤24) }[] } }

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## navigation.anchors

List what an anchor target may point at: each page with the anchors of its own tree, then the header and footer anchors every page shows, marked with their region. Each anchor is labelled with its first heading. Menus are versioned with the site: publish copies them, and the public site serves the published ones.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: ({ pageId: string (min 1), slug: string (min 1), title: string, anchors: ({ anchor: string, name?: string (min 1), label: string, region?: "header" \| "footer" })[] })[]

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## navigation.upsert

Write a whole menu, replacing the menu with its key or adding it after the others. A page or anchor target must name a page of the site; an anchor no section carries yet is a finding, not a refusal. An anchor of the header or footer (navigation.anchors marks it with its `region`) is shown by every page: target it as { kind: "anchor", pageId: <the home page id>, anchor: <the region anchor> }, never with the region's own page id, which is not a page of the site. Menus are versioned with the site: publish copies them, and the public site serves the published ones.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `navigation`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `menu` | object | yes |
| `menu.key` | string (max 40) | yes |
| `menu.label` | string (min 1, max 80) | yes |
| `menu.items` | ({ id: nodeId, label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, target: { kind: "page", pageId: string (min 1, max 36) } \| { kind: "anchor", pageId: string (min 1, max 36), anchor: string } \| { kind: "external", href: string (max 2048) \| Record<locale, …> } \| { kind: "languages" }, children?: (… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { navigation: { revision: integer ≥0, menus: { key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80), items: { id: …, label: …, target: …, children?: … }[] (≤24) }[] } }

Example input:

```json
{"menu":{"key":"main","label":"Main menu","items":[{"id":"item0001","label":{"it":"Il progetto","en":"The project"},"target":{"kind":"anchor","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","anchor":"progetto"}},{"id":"item0002","label":"Studio","target":{"kind":"page","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}},{"id":"item0003","label":"Instagram","target":{"kind":"external","href":"https://www.instagram.com/studio"}},{"id":"item0004","label":"Languages","target":{"kind":"languages"}},{"id":"item0005","label":{"it":"Contatti","en":"Contact"},"target":{"kind":"anchor","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","anchor":"contatti"}}]}}
```

## navigation.delete

Delete a menu; a `menu` prop that names it then draws nothing. Menus are versioned with the site: publish copies them, and the public site serves the published ones.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `navigation`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes |

Output: { navigation: { revision: integer ≥0, menus: { key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80), items: { id: …, label: …, target: …, children?: … }[] (≤24) }[] } }

Example input:

```json
{"key":"footer-legal"}
```

## navigation.reorder

Reorder the items of a menu: `itemIds` names each item once, in the new order. Menus are versioned with the site: publish copies them, and the public site serves the published ones.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `navigation`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes |
| `itemIds` | nodeId[] | yes |

Output: { navigation: { revision: integer ≥0, menus: { key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80), items: { id: …, label: …, target: …, children?: … }[] (≤24) }[] } }

Example input:

```json
{"key":"main","itemIds":["item0002","item0001","item0003","item0004","item0005"]}
```
